title: SEG Implementation Node
description: Schema for an Implementation node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Sourced from repo B (doxygen comment in .h + function body in .c). Authored by the Software Engineer. Discovered via @safety doxygen tag. Node hashes (apiHash, bodyHash, nodeHash, merkleHash) are computed transiently by the extractor and persisted only in sealed proof documents — not stored in this record.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this implementation node. Form: {namespaceBase}/impl/{functionName}. Function name is the locator only — not a semantic anchor. A rename that leaves doxygen comment and @implements tags intact does not change the evidence. Maps to spdxId on SPDX export.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. Maps to spdx:Artifact on SPDX export.

name.description: Function name. Used as the locator for the extractor. Must match the identifier in the id field.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Fixed to repoB for all Implementation nodes. Resolves to the concrete repo URL defined in config.json.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative paths within repo B to the source files for this function. Split into header (doxygen comment, feeds apiHash) and body (function implementation, feeds bodyHash).

header.description: Relative path to the .h file containing the doxygen comment and @safety tag.

body.description: Relative path to the .c file containing the function body.

comment.description: Optional free-text note. Not part of the node content and not included in nodeHash computation.
